source_unit_factory_plan_requirements_st.rule: The typed block definition; its unitPlans are the plans the current plan's requirements come from (UnitPlan holds the unit, the build time and the ItemStack[] requirements).
The frame's current plan index (UnitFactoryBuild.currentPlan, -1 when no plan is set); the ConsumeItemDynamic reads plans.get(currentPlan).requirements, or ItemStack.empty when there is none.
The plan requirements as item stacks (UnitPlan.requirements), the ConsumeItemDynamic rows for the current plan.
The planned build time in ticks (UnitPlan.time).
The planned unit type (UnitPlan.unit), kebab-cased from UnitTypes.

source_unit_factory_tick_buildings_state.rule: The live game world: the placed-building index, the content catalog and the live rules the tick reads every tick.
The frame delta; the wiring itself only refreshes keys, so the delta is carried for the later production/consumption slices.
Per-cell wired frames, keyed by the game cell key like the drill/turret tick results; a cell maps to its refreshed frame dict.
How many placed factory-family builds had their frame keys refreshed this tick.

source_unit_factory_tick_frame_state_inp.rule: The block's implementation, from block.implementation like the drill/turret ticks set it (N2097/N2108); the driver only ticks factory-family builds.

The live game rules (Vars.state.rules, N2098), returned as-is so the cheat read stays live.
The building's team id, from the sprite's team meta; cheating() reads this team's TeamRule.

source_unit_factory_tick_frame_state_res.rule: The wired frame, with block_implementation, team_id, rules_state and the live cheating flag set.
